/*
 * wow64_cb_automarshal.c — GENERATED by tools/wow64gen/marshalgen.py. DO NOT EDIT.
 *
 * 64<->32 marshallers for win32k WINDOWPROC callback payloads (the
 * KeUserModeCallback direction). Field offsets come from clang record-layout
 * dumps at both -target i686-w64-mingw32 and aarch64-w64-mingw32.
 * See wow64_callback.c for how Down/Up are dispatched around the guest call.
 *
 * Regenerate:  python3 tools/wow64gen/marshalgen.py gen-callback
 */

typedef unsigned int ULONG;
typedef int LONG;
typedef long long LONGLONG;

static void WowCbCpy(unsigned char *d, const unsigned char *s, unsigned n)
{
    while (n--) *d++ = *s++;
}

static void WowCbZero(unsigned char *d, unsigned n)
{
    while (n--) *d++ = 0;
}

/* 4 -> 8 sign-extend (handles: pseudo/special values like HWND_TOPMOST(-1)
 * are only correct sign-extended) */
static void WowCbSx(unsigned char *d, const unsigned char *s)
{
    LONG v;
    LONGLONG w;
    WowCbCpy((unsigned char *)&v, s, 4);
    w = (LONGLONG)v;
    WowCbCpy(d, (const unsigned char *)&w, 8);
}

/* 8 -> 4 narrow */
static void WowCbNx(unsigned char *d, const unsigned char *s)
{
    WowCbCpy(d, s, 4);
}

/* struct _DRAWITEMSTRUCT: 32-bit 12b <-> 64-bit 24b */
void WowCbDown__DRAWITEMSTRUCT(const unsigned char *s, unsigned char *d)
{
    WowCbZero(d, 12);
    WowCbCpy(d + 0, s + 0, 4); /* cbSize */
    WowCbNx(d + 4, s + 8); /* handle */
    WowCbNx(d + 8, s + 16); /* ptr */
}

void WowCbUp__DRAWITEMSTRUCT(const unsigned char *s, unsigned char *d)
{
    WowCbCpy(d + 0, s + 0, 4); /* cbSize */
    WowCbSx(d + 8, s + 4); /* handle */
    /* ptr: kernel pointer preserved (guest value is scratch) */
}

typedef struct _WOW64_CB_MARSHAL {
    unsigned int Msg;
    unsigned int Size32;
    unsigned int Size64;
    void (*Down)(const unsigned char *, unsigned char *);
    void (*Up)(const unsigned char *, unsigned char *);
} WOW64_CB_MARSHAL;

static const WOW64_CB_MARSHAL Wow64CbMarshalTable[] = {
    { 0x002B /* WM_DRAWITEM */, 12, 24, WowCbDown__DRAWITEMSTRUCT, WowCbUp__DRAWITEMSTRUCT },
    { 0x002C /* WM_MEASUREITEM */, 12, 24, WowCbDown__MEASUREITEMSTRUCT, WowCbUp__MEASUREITEMSTRUCT },
    { 0x0053 /* WM_HELP */, 12, 24, WowCbDown__HELPINFO, WowCbUp__HELPINFO },
    { 0x0213 /* WM_NEXTMENU */, 12, 24, WowCbDown__MDINEXTMENU, WowCbUp__MDINEXTMENU },
    { 0x0046 /* WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING */, 12, 24, WowCbDown__WINDOWPOS, WowCbUp__WINDOWPOS },
    { 0x0047 /* WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED */, 12, 24, WowCbDown__WINDOWPOS, WowCbUp__WINDOWPOS },
};

const WOW64_CB_MARSHAL *Wow64CbFindMarshal(unsigned int Msg)
{
    unsigned int i;
    for (i = 0; i < sizeof(Wow64CbMarshalTable) /
                    sizeof(Wow64CbMarshalTable[0]); i++)
        if (Wow64CbMarshalTable[i].Msg == Msg)
            return &Wow64CbMarshalTable[i];
    return 0;
}
